episodes.title: From Isolation to Independence: Sarah Schauffler's Journey Beyond a Cult
episodes.description:
What happens when the people and community meant to protect you are the very ones who leave you feeling unwanted, isolated and unworthy?


In this episode of Shedding the Shame, I'm joined by Sarah Schauffler, who spent her childhood inside the Unification Church, commonly known as the Moonies. Born before her parents' marriage was blessed by the church's leader, Sarah was labelled a "Jacob's child" and taught that she was somehow less worthy than the children born after their parents' blessed marriages.


Her childhood was marked by abandonment, neglect, instability and bullying, both within her family and the church community. She shares what it was like growing up without a consistent sense of belonging, how those early experiences shaped her self-worth and relationships, and the lasting impact of being made to feel that she was never good enough.


We talk about the connection between childhood trauma and disordered eating, the fear of abandonment, perfectionism, family estrangement and the long process of learning to recognize that what happened to you matters, even when someone else may have experienced something different.


Sarah also opens up about leaving the church at 18 following a mental health crisis, spending years in therapy, and slowly building a life that feels like her own. Today, she's a teacher, alternative hair educator and business owner who has found purpose, stability and happiness on her own terms.


This is a conversation about owning your trauma without comparing it to anyone else's, setting boundaries with people you love, letting go of the expectations society places on women, and realizing that a fulfilling life doesn't have to look the way you once imagined.


Trigger warning: This episode includes discussion of cult involvement, childhood neglect and abandonment, bullying, disordered eating, mental health challenges and family estrangement.
